input.note: Round 1 is the roster: `N K`, then the `N` student records `id g1 ... gK` back-to-back. Every later round is a batch: a count `O`, then `O` operations back-to-back.

output.note: A round's output is its GET/AVG/TOP replies, in operation order. The roster round and SET operations produce no output.

constraints: student ids distinct, `1000 ≤ id ≤ 9999`, not dense, not sorted
every operation references an existing id and a subject in `1..K`
1–10 batch rounds per test case, 1–8 operations per batch
one roster per test case (no reload)
